'''Aimee Kraeff''', better known by her stage name, '''Flutterplume''', was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] native to the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
The daughter of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] settlers, Aimee Kraeff was raised in the farming village of [[Redlake]], a small settlement on the edge of the [[Scraplands/Legends|Scraplands]] near [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]]. Working to support her family, Kraeff eventually abandoned her home in the Scraplands in hope of finding a better existence elsewhere. A teenager alone in the wastes, Kraeff was beset by [[Mantellian Savrip/Legends|Savrips]] in an attack that left her severely scarred and half-dead. Rescued by nomads, she was nursed back to health in the village before being taken to [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]].
[[File:Fight_Night_The_Loaded_Savrip_Proudly_Presents_Flutterplume.png|thumb|left|200px|A holographic advertisement promoting Flutterplume]]
While participating in underground blood sports to survive on the streets, Kraeff discovered a knack for fighting and eventually earned a reputation for herself. Going by the stage name "Flutterplume", so called for her exotic outfit and feathered mask and its resemblance to the [[Mantellian flutterplume/Legends|bird of the same name]], Kraeff managed to get a stable income to support herself and her apartment in Westwall District. Taking on four fights a week, Flutterplume hoped to make herself a small fortune so as to better help her parents, whom she sent credits to on a regular basis. When not fighting, Kraeff used a pair of [[Vibroknuckler/Legends|vibroknucklers]] for her own protection on the streets.<ref name="MPQ" />

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the [[Gambler/Legends|gambler]] [[Illo Vandin]] wanted to see Kraeff throw her match to bring shame upon one of her avid fans and the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic's]] rival, the [[Pirate Queen/Legends|Pirate Queen]] of the [[Veiled Sorority/Legends|Veiled Sorority]]. Sending agents to speak with her on three occasions, Vandin had grown impatient with her commitment to winning the bout. At the same time, Kraeff was concerned with the well-being of her family, who unbeknownst to her, had been abducted by slavers and taken to the town [[Rusty Reach]].<ref name="MPQ" />
